findings.message: Declaring an optional parameter with a non-nullable type and a null default value before a required parameter is deprecated since PHP 8.4 Parameter $content is optional, while parameter $name is required. The $content parameter is implicitly treated as a required parameter.
Implicitly marking a parameter as nullable is deprecated since PHP 8.4. Update the type to be explicitly nullable instead. Found implicitly nullable parameter: $content.
